title: Bank return quantiles given rate and credit conditions
description: Distribution of the next-month financials return given the curve slope, credit spread and VIX.
question: forecasting
method_note: Banks' downside depends on credit stress and the curve. Quantile boosting reveals whether the left tail widens more than the median moves; CQR guarantees marginal coverage out of fold. Caveat: the universe is today's constituents (membership history starts 2026-10), so early years carry survivorship bias; read the premium as an upper bound.

result.verdict: quantile GBM beats linear-Gaussian baseline on CRPS (DM p = 0.00101); point forecast: quantile GBM (median) is worse than linear baseline out of sample (mean loss 0.003922 vs 0.003725)
